resumeText:
Ananya Krishnan | Bengaluru | ananya.krishnan@example.com

SUMMARY
Machine learning engineering manager with 13 years in applied ML, the last 5 leading ML and GenAI teams in retail technology.

EXPERIENCE
Manager - Machine Learning, Nimbus Retail Tech, Bengaluru (2021 - present)
- Lead a team of 9 ML engineers and data scientists across search ranking, pricing and GenAI.
- Hired 6 engineers and ran interview loops for all ML roles.
- Shipped an LLM-based product Q&A assistant using RAG over the catalogue to 20 million monthly users.
- Set up MLflow model registry, drift monitoring and weekly retraining for 14 production models.
- Defined precision recall targets and online conversion metrics that decide whether a ranking model ships.
- Built LLM-as-a-judge checks that gate every assistant release.
- Review design documents for training pipelines, feature stores and low-latency model serving.
- Plan the quarterly ML roadmap with product managers and agree launch scope with category business heads.
- Cut inference spend by 35% by moving to batched serving on Amazon SageMaker.

Senior Machine Learning Engineer, Kaveri Analytics, Bengaluru (2016 - 2021)
- Built gradient boosted demand forecasting models for 400 grocery stores.
- Led 4 engineers as tech lead for the forecasting service and owned its architecture decisions.
- Trained deep learning models in PyTorch for product image tagging.

Data Scientist, Sahyadri Infotech, Pune (2013 - 2016)
- Built churn and propensity models with logistic regression for telecom clients.

SKILLS
Python, SQL, PyTorch, scikit-learn, MLflow, Amazon SageMaker, LangChain

EDUCATION
MTech Computer Science, IIIT Hyderabad, 2013
